notes.title: Patch Notes 0.7 "God's Synthesis"
notes.notes: [p]Hello, fellow mercenaries![/p][p]This is Graham, the programmer, and as always thank you for playing our game! We are happy to announce the next update, "God's Synthesis", adding on a lot of exciting new content and fixing a few bugs.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]1) New Stage - Abandoned Mines[/h2][p]A mine that has taken on a new form of life. You will encounter both the Phian and Aigam armies in this stage, as well as new types of enemies that have lived peacefully up until now. With the location of God's Synthesis finally confirmed, time is of the essence. Retrieve this artifact before either armies do![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/836e2b40e265401a39e9e6fea2bc2a179461b2b9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]2) New Mercenary - Punk[/h2][p]Punk, the shapeshifting brawler, joins the Guild![/p][p]He relies on switching between his human and kangaroo stance to gain the advantage of any situation.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/7aa0d101be605a6936587231838f2800057256a9.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/4fdb3a89ff6108041a3c77a294ee06afd606736e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/4f1a09ada9dd11352d17512fa4226286865456fc.png"][/img][/p][h3]Left Hook / Bullet Kick (Auto Attack)[/h3][list][*][p]Level 1 Description:[/p][list][*][p]Human: Short hook punch.[/p][list][*][p]Damage: 100%[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Kangaroo: Long wind kick[/p][list][*][p]Damage: 75%   Pierce: 3[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/5dfde55af79fa8be34094bab4ec2411bba6c56d3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/fe28412f299bc6bb434f21a6588feceec03abd78.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/a7588bd9113c4623d599518147ed1efa64ef2b89.png"][/img][/p][h3]Stance Change (Active)[/h3][list][*][p]Level 1 Description:[/p][list][*][p]Change between Human and Kangaroo Form.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/dbcc2f3006fc65d9304a8b64fa4d030c6abfede3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/0652129f5265fe12b5de62ac17285e0c734743c2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/13923c7dac89655aea07f46678ab362a7bd045ab.png"][/img][/p][h3]Counter Punch / Battle Roar (Passive 1)[/h3][list][*][p]Level 1 Description:[/p][list][*][p]Upon changing to Human: For 2s, unable to auto attack but can counter 1 attack. notes.title: Version 0.5.1.5 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello fellow mercenaries,

Hope you are liking the new game mode! Here are just some quick fixes.

[list]
[*] Changed the font for Usernames in the Survival Leaderboard so that both Japanese and English characters will show.
[*] Added a 60 second timer on Mob XPs to prevent later game runs from being performance heavy.
[*] Fixed a bug where Side Objectives did not shuffle correctly.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.5 "Lady Luck's Survival"
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, fellow mercenaries!
As always, thanks for playing our game!
I'm Graham, the programmer for Capybara Forge, and I get the privilege to tell you about this new update.  Sorry that this update took too long. It was solely because of me :(
Today I will be talking about the new additions for this upcoming update such as the new mode, index, new weapon/armor/item, balances, and key bindings!
Let's get to it right now!



[/p][h2]1) New Mode - Survival[/h2][p]- In Survival Mode, you will have to survive as long as possible until you die or when the timer runs out. You can gain more time such as by killing mobs and completing objectives!
Your mercenary will be at a fixed rank depending on the difficulty.
Normal: Rank 5 | Hard: Rank 10
Survival Mode will be already unlocked but we recommend you to at least play through Standard Mode mode first.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/31c0c157fd69e0baf2eb7455dae6805fdaa5416d.png"][/img][/p][h3]Survival Mode (Mechanics)[/h3][p]Mechanics vary compared to Standard Mode as completing the main objective will immediately spawn the Final Boss; where as in Standard Mode, the door to the Subspace opens.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/23c77b4a952c24c2ef49c0daefae2a2e20e06ec7.png"][/img]Not only this but, you will be able to proceed to the next stage after beating the Final Boss and leaving the Subspace! As there are only 2 stages, you will loop back to the the first stage after beating the second.

There will also be [b]new mechanics unique to Survival Mode![/b]
[/p][h3]- Perks[/h3][p]Perks can be purchased with Kredits that give you a further edge in battle. 3 random perks will be available every stage. Interact with the book at the Subspace Bar to have a look!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/a1f446410a636910183911a839c1ca1d4c9b0df3.png"][/img]
[/p][h3]- Weapon Upgrades[/h3][p]Your overdriven weapons can be further enhanced by using the anvil on the bottom left of Subspace. Remember that you must overdrive a weapon first in order to upgrade them.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/d3cb602f8e3b60c0be3458c85e78931b83b7fa27.png"][/img]
[/p][h3]- Mutations[/h3][p]Every time you enter a stage a new mutation appears! They will stay indefinitely every run and more will come to increase the difficulty of a Survival run.
When getting an existing mutation it will further increase the effect of that mutation too!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/96d1380ad162d621867c24a1a9f4da99af65244d.png"][/img]To look at the active Perks and Mutations, you can look at them in the Pause Menu under the "Perks, Mutations" Button.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/9af12825a73d4a2a6c09fe8644223963d97b8a8d.png"][/img]
[/p][h3]- Leaderboard[/h3][p]Compete against yourself or globally! Your Survival runs get stored on the Personal and Global Leaderboards if you get a high score!
It will save your Steam username, score, time, mercenary, and the overdriven skill if any!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/cba3e2da58d0872488bfb687fdb58270a2bf3886.png"][/img]That's all we have to talk about for Survival Mode.
We will be tweaking/adding more Perks and Mutations as we keep on updating the game so hopefully you will be able to enjoy this mode every update.
Also, when a new stage comes out, we will be adding that stage to Survival Mode as well.




[/p][h2]2) New Mercenary - Gambler[/h2][p]Gambler, the crazed, gambling eccentric joins the guild!
Her playstyle depends on luck but she has the utility to defend herself if she needs it!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/9e8446121a14d2f97323b677ab792831e7c1346f.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/fc1da5246b01b5aa35f0d0970392bd7e6e7f1c5c.png"][/img] [/p][h3]Fated Die (Auto Attack)[/h3][p]- Level 1 Description:
-- Throws a die.
-- Damage: 1 - 6 (Fixed)
-- Different effects can occur depending on damage.
-- On crit, throw 2 dice.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/8a6532a9c44c87e0ddd218e91cdb926543f47bfa.gif"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/7375c876bd8c32e2e2c4534e7900f247b8a82aa4.png"][/img] [/p][h3]Royal Draw (Active)[/h3][p]- Level 1 Description:
-- Throws a random card. Inflicts a random effect depending on card drawn.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/3d4922c726292ab714f12a36ad8e167b1f058007.gif"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/b5abe968fee8a366d0ff7a46e40d2bb005127075.png"][/img] [/p][h3]Adrenaline (Passive 1)[/h3][p]-- Level 1 Description:
--- MVT SPD: +20% for 5s (when Auto Attack crits)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/0f3a345fd7f94d49e896f36249645f6a72a319b2.png"][/img] [/p][h3]Karma (Passive 2)[/h3][p]- Level 1 Description:
-- When Gambler gets hit, drop dice around her.
-- CD: 30s

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/646a7ea9c2a7e7c456126b6554f0e0c97ab806b2.gif"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/60eaacfa9f33d72bfefd5a77d9d363bde40830e9.png"][/img] [/p][h3]Roulette of Fortune (Ultimate)[/h3][p]- Level 1 Description:
-- Gambler bets on a color by activating the Ultimate again in which a giant roulette crashes down. 
-- If bet is won, activate the certain effect corresponding to the color.
-- Red = ATK: +20% & DEF: +5% (30s)   Black = Explosion (Damage: 300%)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/832f644377282c1c23927089adac1aa86c8533d9.gif"][/img]Gambler was the one of the first mercenaries that I designed but due to her complexity we held it back until this update lol.
We hope you will like the new mercenary as much as we enjoyed making her!
Also as a side note: Her theme song is really cool too once you get to it!




[/p][h2]3) New Weapon, Armor, & Item[/h2][p]We added 1 new weapon, 1 armor, and 1 item that goes along with the theme of Gambler!



 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/fcb8bbd5d0dd8a075c5718d1c97feb1016c2c47e.png"][/img] [/p][h3]Strange Wanderer (Weapon)[/h3][p]- Level 1 Description: 
-- Shoot an ordinary bullet.
-- Damage: 100%
-- Chance to summon the Strange Wanderer (5%)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/6ac1950acdc17ab0519684137eb9cedb8608b2a9.gif"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/5daa4e7d7d86388a60e740715bb1853c067e4db4.png"][/img] [/p][h3]Jackpot Machine (Armor)[/h3][p]- Level 1 Description:
-- When hit, a slot machine falls down from above and knocks enemies back.
-- Will either roll Kredits, Power Ups, or Food.
-- Damage: 100 (Fixed)

notes.title: TH3-M15 GUILD Development Log: 1
notes.notes:
Hello Fellow Mercenaries,

To start, we want to express our gratitude to everyone who has purchased the game and to those who have taken the time to provide feedback. Your support means a lot to us! It has been around three months since the Early Access launch, and we're excited to share our very first development log here on steam.

To kick off the log, we will introduce the new character that will accompany the first update.

Meet the new mercenary, [b]Gambler![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/9e8446121a14d2f97323b677ab792831e7c1346f.gif[/img]

The new character was inspired by the ideas of RNG (Random Number Generator) and luck, leading to the creation of Lady Luck herself, The Gambler. She will unleash chaos on the battlefield, wielding dice and playing cards to create explosive effects and dazzling fireworks.

Next are the new items, starting from the top 
- Weapon: [b]Strange Wanderer[/b]
- Armor: [b]J4-CK-P0T Machine[/b]
- Item: [b]Coin Launcher[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/e3c44de87ab8d0cbba9cb5a891ef11d78542498f.gif[/img]

The new character and items have been completely integrated into the game and are currently undergoing playtesting.

Next, we will introduce some new features included in the upcoming update.

First is the Index, here you can find information about the Mercenaries, Items, and Enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/fb9c15cf2b325e1e2515204b035d0993ef6b1f88.gif[/img]

The other feature allows you to remap keys and controllers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646067/a524311cb0c69d6ff5ba91562b0bc6ee92ef37a5.gif[/img]

This concludes the current development log. We are now playtesting all the new features and additions while our programmer focuses on developing the “Survival Mode” game mode.

For more frequent updates, we invite you to join our Discord server, where we share development logs on a monthly basis.

https://discord.gg/uF3bmvG6Kg

notes.title: New Patch for Demo!
notes.notes:
Hello Mercenaries!

Thank you so much for playing our game! It means the world to us that actual people would try this game out!

This patch includes balances changes to all playable mercenaries and mobs due to overhauling how defense works including some bug fixes that were found ever since the release of this demo.

[b]Version 0.18.6.1[/b]
Purpose of Overhauling the DEF Stat:
There would be moments in the game where the player would deal 1 damage to an enemy because of their low ATK compared to a mob's high DEF. We want to make sure that even dealing low damage is a viable option as it will lead to more interesting strategies.

Major Changes:
[list]
[*] Defense Stat is now calculated as a [b]percent[/b] instead of a flat amount.
[*] All mobs have increased HP.
[*] All mobs have decreased ATK due to DEF overhaul.
[*] A Weapon, Muses' Whisper,  has lower damage.
[*] An Overdriven Weapon, Kur's Fang (which was call Tiamat before being overdriven), has increased damage.
[*] BattleTOP has higher DEF & MVT SPD.
[*] Karambit has lower ATK. Has higher HP & MVT SPD.
[*] Old Man has slightly lower HP.
[*] BattleTOP's Overdriven Auto Attack has increased damage and can now inflict burn.
[*] Karambit's Overdriven Auto Attack has lower damage.
[*] Burn Ailment ticks twice as fast.
[*] Harder to achieve S-Ranks after completing the mission.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug when teleporting to the Server Room, the minimap does not update to display the correct location.
[*] Fixed a bug where a player cannot reach a Care Package because it is in a place where the player cannot travel towards. When the Care Package is in this state, it will now slide towards the player until it is in reach for the player to get.
[*] Fixed a bug where a SFX would constantly still play in the Care Package Menu.
[*] Fixed a bug where a button on the Settings would still be able to be pressed when transitioning out of it.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Help Button on Pause was still clickable even when on Settings.
[/list]
